axes.concept: An event production call sheet: people are registered against their exact tools, access state and next action. The ring-and-dot Pictures mark and foil seam connect the operational page to Sempertex installations.
axes.layout: Broad asymmetric running head (large condensed title left, live account count right), horizontal route rule, full-width ruled register with a narrow plan annotation rail; role list and permission sheet replace the register without a dashboard-card grid. Phone stacks the register then plan annotation.
axes.navigation: Neutral horizontal in-flow Cuentas / Roles y permisos / Mi cuenta route buttons, contextual per-person Manage dialogs and a named account disclosure; invitation-only entry has no open-registration route. Native preview selectors remain outside the product.
axes.typography: Embedded DejaVu Sans Condensed Bold as Dispatch, 38–68px display, 23–28px section/dialog titles; embedded Adwaita Sans as Work at 14–16px, embedded Adwaita Mono as Measure at 11–13px for access timestamps and edition details. English and Spanish reflow.
axes.density: Compact ruled account rows with name/email/company/role/state/last access/actions, flat paper fields, square 2px control corners and generous 24px desktop / 20px phone container padding; no KPI tiles.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Checkbox and Skeleton; Animate UI Dialog and AlertDialog with focus containment. Custom register rows, production running head, permission fieldsets and foil seam. Native role/state/language selects, no snippet fallback.
axes.colour: Proposed local exploration mapping of Pictures semantic roles: cold steel #e4ebf2, ink #112c48, cobalt #12489e; dark navy #0b1c2e with #a6caff action. Copper foil is confined to a Sempertex material sample; green/amber/red name status meaning. Neutral navigation uses text and a rule, not the accent.
axes.motion: Precise kinetic registration, cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1), expressive 480ms sheets with 55ms row offsets and 180ms controls; distinct paper registration, row registration, rule registration, rail counter-motion, 900ms foil stamp, 6s ambient foil registration, status stamping, skeleton scan and hover/press arrow shift. Subtle/natural shorten timings. Content remains visible during travel. Reduced/still removes all animation; hidden/offscreen suspension.
